Subject: Invitation: Joint Webinar & Panel — Helix AI + Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha / Devon,

Hope you both had a good week. Redwood is putting together a short joint webinar and customer panel for mid-April focused on "Scaling low-latency LLM inference in production." We would love for a Helix AI customer leader to join as a featured speaker to discuss your rollout and lessons learned.

High-level concept: 30-minute session — 10 minute intro (Redwood), 15 minute customer spotlight (Helix), 5 minute moderated Q&A. We want the customer segment to highlight architecture choices, quantization/latency tradeoffs, and measured cost/latency improvements.

Proposed slot options: Wednesday, April 21 at 11:00 AM PT or Wednesday, April 28 at 11:00 AM PT.

What we need from Helix:
- A single speaker (engineer or product lead) comfortable with technical detail
- Short bio + 1 headshot for promotion (by Mar 24)
- Marketing/legal OK for logo + a one-paragraph case-study blurb (by Mar 30)

I attached a draft agenda and a speaker blurb template to make this quick. If you're interested, can you confirm the preferred date and whether we should loop in PR/Legal? We can also make the session private invitation-only for joint customers if you prefer.

Thanks — excited about the opportunity to feature Helix.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the invite; Helix would be happy to participate in principle. April 28 looks better for us (April 21 conflicts with our product roadmap review). I need to confirm a couple of internal items before I can lock the speaker:

- Legal/Comms approval for logo and case-study language (I can escalate).
- Confirming which Helix leader will present (likely an engineering manager).

Could you send the detailed moderator questions and the expected audience profile (devs, platforms, CTOs)? Also, we prefer the customer segment be ~20 minutes so the speaker can show a short demo and results.

I can aim to have a firm yes and the speaker name by Mar 16 and assets by Mar 24 if Legal moves quickly.

Appreciate the flexibility — Devon and I will coordinate on the internal approvals.

Best,
